root_cause.text: The erofs directory parser lacked a bounds check on the `nameoff` field of the last dirent in a directory block, enabling a crafted filesystem with `nameoff >= maxsize` to cause integer underflow in `maxsize - nameoff`, resulting in an out-of-bounds read by `strnlen()`.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `else if (maxsize <= nameoff) goto err_bogus;` for the trailing dirent case, and the commit message states: "If a crafted EROFS has a trailing dirent with nameoff >= maxsize, maxsize - nameoff can underflow, causing strnlen() to read past the directory block."
